arm_A.constraints: NonlinearConstraint over the catalogue callables (le: g <= 0, eq: h == 0)
arm_A.maxiter: floor(0.9 * budget / (popsize * d)) - 1, so the polish has about a tenth of the budget
arm_A.multi_objective: Tchebycheff scalarisation over 50 weights, each by the same DE with 1/50 of the budget; the two extreme weights first, the ideal point is the best value seen

arm_B.black_box: exhaustive enumeration of the integer grid sorted by the objective expression (the stated cost, read without a black-box call), stopping at the first feasible point; differential evolution with integrality when the grid exceeds the budget
arm_B.convex_qp: minimize(method='trust-constr') from the box centre, 3-point finite differences, BFGS Hessians, TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS (tuning_adjustments)
arm_B.lp: linprog(method='highs') on coefficients probed from the callables (d + 1 evaluations)
arm_B.milp: milp (HiGHS) on probed coefficients, integrality 1 on every variable
arm_B.multi_objective: Tchebycheff over 50 weights in epigraph form, each by the nlp rule with 1/50 of the budget
arm_B.nlp: minimize(method='SLSQP') from seeded uniform starts until the evaluation budget is spent

protocol.evaluation: one evaluation = objectives and constraints at one point; an exact repeat of a point inside a cell is served from the cell's cache at no cost (the IR adapters' rule)
protocol.fault_hosts: the seed-0 result of every rule arm on every scoring instance, plus the stored reference optimum where the catalogue has one; graded in memory (verify_result) and as a sealed run (verify_run)
protocol.jobs: one process per family runs that family's shards for every arm in turn (A, B, E-rule, C, D, E-LLM), so the arms of one instance share a host and its load; at most four such processes at once
protocol.scoring: catalogue callables; violation adds |x - round(x)| for integer and binary variables; a front keeps at most 50 points and only points inside the bounds

seeds.why: the spec's own seeds (section 5): 10 scoring seeds, 5 tuning seeds

protocol.shard: arm x family x every seed of the split; fault-matrix shards per family

statistics.ci: cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 1410, strata = family
statistics.cost: exact Wilcoxon on per-instance log ERT ratio (spec)
statistics.gap: exact Wilcoxon on per-instance log10 median gap (secondary)
statistics.holm: primary family of the spec's 15 hypotheses, not-run hypotheses count as p = 1; E-rule comparisons as a separate secondary family
statistics.success: cluster sign-flip on per-instance discordance (spec); exact McNemar on seed 0 as a check

tuning_adjustments.after: jac and constraint jac '3-point', hess BFGS, gtol = xtol = barrier_tol = 1e-12, initial_barrier_parameter = 1e-6: gap 8.7e-13 after 85 evaluations
tuning_adjustments.before: trust-constr scipy defaults: gtol termination at gap 1.6e-4 after 27 evaluations
SLSQP default ftol 1e-6: five starts end at f = 7e-9 to 2.5e-7, all within the 1e-6 tolerance
tuning dry run of code 63c30a2 (120 cells): every cell within budget and replayed EQUAL; the budget bound only where the rule spends all of it by design (B nlp and B multi_objective)
